title: 16-06-pace-code-c-2015.pdf — section 22
text:
3.17 If the other location mentioned in paragraph 3.16 is any place or
premises for which the interviewer requires the person’s informed
consent to remain, for example, the person’s home, then the
references that the person is ‘not obliged to remain’ and that they
‘may leave at will’ means that the person may also withdraw their
consent and require the interviewer to leave.
(d) Documentation

3.18 The grounds for a person’s detention shall be recorded, in the
person’s presence if practicable. See paragraph 1.8.

3.19 Action taken under paragraphs 3.7 to 3.15 shall be recorded.
 18
(e) Persons answering street bail

3.20 When a person is answering street bail, the custody officer should
link any documentation held in relation to arrest with the custody
record. Any further action shall be recorded on the custody record
in accordance with paragraphs 3.18 and 3.19 above.
